KT_MIND/01_inprocess_36s.mp4:
"I will" keeps your goal in someday. Two other words start it today.

Kevin explains the difference between saying "I will" and saying "I am in the process."

"I will" puts the goal in the future, where it can wait forever. "I am in the process" is true the moment you take one small step, and your mind can believe it.

What are you doing right now that proves you're in the process?

#ad #mindset #goals #kevintrudeau
KT_MIND/01_selfimageblocks_47s.mp4:
Why saying the right words still gets you nowhere.

Kevin talks about the picture you carry of yourself. When you say something that doesn't match that picture, your mind pushes back.

The result is conflict instead of progress. The words were fine; the picture behind them was never updated.

What does the picture you carry of yourself say right now?

#ad #mindset #selfimage #kevintrudeau
KT_MIND/02_firstwordwish_63s.mp4:
The first step toward a big goal is not "I want." It's smaller.

Kevin explains why wanting something is not where it starts. There is a smaller, simpler word that comes first, and most people skip it.

It sounds too easy to matter. That is exactly why it gets ignored.

Would you be willing to say it out loud today?

#ad #mindset #goals #kevintrudeau
KT_MIND/02_lastwords_47s.mp4:
Some words belong at the finish line, not at the start.

Kevin explains why the big statement about who you want to be is where you finish, not where you begin.

Start with words your mind can accept today, then climb one step at a time. Jump to the top too early and your mind simply doesn't believe it.

Where are you on that ladder right now?

#ad #mindset #affirmations #kevintrudeau
KT_MINDSET/01_becomewhatthink_52s.mp4:
The strangest secret is one sentence, and most people laugh at it.

Kevin recalls the classic Earl Nightingale recording: you become what you think about most of the time.

He laughed the first time he heard it, because as a young man he was always thinking about girls. The room laughed too, but they got the point. You become what you think about and feel about most of the time.

Thoughts are things. So control your thoughts and feelings, feel good now, and keep working on a better you.

What do you think about most of the time?

#ad #mindset #thoughts #kevintrudeau
KT_MINDSET/01_fivesecondmiracle_36s.mp4:
He waited years for a "five-second miracle." It was one sentence.

Kevin sat on the edge of his seat, expecting something huge. The lesson: take 100 percent responsibility for everything that happens in your life, without exception and without condition.

Then everyone stood, shook his hand, and it was over.

Kevin says it takes five seconds to hear and years to live.

What would change if you took that sentence seriously?

#ad #mindset #responsibility #kevintrudeau
KT_RELATIONSHIPS/01_truthhonesty_32s.mp4:
Every word he said was true. He still wasn't honest.

A man comes home from lunch and tells his wife where he went and what he ate. All true.

What he leaves out is who he had lunch with. He didn't lie, but he wasn't honest either.

Kevin says telling the truth and being honest are not the same thing, and small omissions build a quiet wall between people.

Where have you noticed the gap between the two?

#ad #relationships #communication #kevintrudeau
KT_RELATIONSHIPS/01_yourcircle_30s.mp4:
Asked what he'd do with a messy roommate, his answer surprised everyone.

Kevin says he simply wouldn't have that roommate, because he wouldn't be in that situation.

The people around him are honest, kind, loving and good communicators. Nobody pushes his buttons.

His view: the people in your world reflect the person you are, and what you attract.

What does your circle reflect back to you?

#ad #mindset #relationships #kevintrudeau
KT_RELATIONSHIPS/02_soulmate_57s.mp4:
Is there only one person on the planet meant for you? Look at the odds.

Kevin gives a straight answer on the soulmate question.

Believing there is exactly one person out of billions is a stretch. He compares it to asking whether any other planet could support life.

There are likely many people you could connect with deeply, and that changes how you look for someone.

Do you believe in the one, or in many?

#ad #relationships #love #kevintrudeau
KT_CREDIT/01_chargecardhistory_54s.mp4:
There was a time nobody carried a credit card. Here's what changed.

Back then you had a charge account at the local store, or a charge card from a handful of companies. It was for convenience, so you didn't carry a lot of cash.

Kevin explains how different that world was from the one we live in now, and why the difference matters.

What do you think changed most between then and today?

#ad #credit #money #kevintrudeau
KT_CREDIT/01_housingtoomuch_58s.mp4:
The old cash rule almost nobody follows anymore.

If you can't pay for it with cash, Kevin says you can't afford it, with the possible exception of a house and a car.

Then he looks at housing. Many people hand too large a share of their income to the home once you add the mortgage, insurance and upkeep.

He's not a financial planner and says so. It's common sense to apply to your own situation.

What share of your income goes to housing?

#ad #budget #money #kevintrudeau
KT_CREDIT/01_reportingdate_50s.mp4:
Paying on time may not be enough for your credit score. Here's why.

Most of us think the due date is all that matters. Kevin explains the card company usually reports your balance to the credit agencies 10 to 15 days before that date.

His advice: ask your card company when they report, and pay the balance before that day.

A small timing change he calls the magic secret.

Did you know your report date and your due date can be different?

#ad #credit #creditscore #kevintrudeau
KT_CREDIT/01_strongcreditfile_47s.mp4:
What a strong credit file looks like, and why more cards can hurt it.

Kevin's picture: two installment loans, like a mortgage and a car payment, plus three revolving lines of credit. More than that can pull the score down, because it means too much available credit.

He also mentions a home equity line and a line against a stock portfolio, which can sit available without being used.

Which part of your own credit file do you understand least?

#ad #credit #creditscore #kevintrudeau
KT_CREDIT/02_belowmeans_33s.mp4:
"Live within your means" is advice Kevin says isn't enough.

You have to live below your means.

He points to how his father's generation handled money. Housing was a small share of income, and cars weren't financed. They paid cash, and until they could, they went without.

An old habit, and Kevin says it's still a strong one.

What's one expense you could trim to live below your means?

#ad #money #mindset #kevintrudeau
KT_CREDIT/02_chargevscredit_53s.mp4:
Charge card or credit card? One small difference changes everything.

With a charge card, the money had to already be in your bank. Sometimes the company even checked with your bank first.

With a credit card, you can spend money you don't have. Kevin explains that one was a convenience; the other lets you spend beyond what you hold.

A simple distinction worth keeping in mind.

When you use a card, do you check your account balance first?

#ad #credit #money #kevintrudeau
KT_CREDIT/02_zerobalances_54s.mp4:
What it actually feels like when every card is at zero.

Kevin paints the picture: cards at zero, payments current, and some savings set aside for a rainy day.

He says that kind of order brings a feeling of strength and control, and the confidence carries into every other part of your life.

It's less about the numbers and more about the peace of mind.

What would having zero balances change for you?

#ad #debtfree #mindset #kevintrudeau
KT_MINDSET4/02_choosefeel_61s.mp4:
The biggest mistake people make in hard times starts with one word.

Kevin says it's calling it adversity in the first place. It is simply a situation, and nobody else makes you feel a certain way.

He shares the story of Viktor Frankl, who said others could control everything around him, but not his thoughts.

The lesson: you choose what you think, and what you think shapes how you feel.

Where in your life could you choose your thoughts on purpose?

#ad #mindset #kevintrudeau
KT_MINDSET5/01_caddyrich_52s.mp4:
He became a caddy for one reason: to watch how successful people think.

Kevin grew up in a blue collar town. So he took a job at a country club where the members were wealthy, and he watched them closely.

They talked, thought and carried themselves differently. But they were normal people, just like his dad.

The real difference was how they thought and saw themselves. That's when he knew he could do it too.

Who are you spending your time around?

#ad #success #mindset #kevintrudeau
KT_MINDSET5/01_workforself_43s.mp4:
A welder's son learned early that he wanted to be his own boss.

Kevin grew up on a street where everyone worked a job, hoped to get into the union and dreamed of a government pension.

He learned early that he had to work for himself.

That lesson sent him to the library to read about people who became very successful.

What did you learn early about work from the people around you?

#ad #entrepreneur #mindset #kevintrudeau
KT_MINDSET5/02_houndpain_46s.mp4:
Why the old dog keeps moaning but never gets up.

Two men sit on a porch. An old hound dog keeps moaning but never moves. One asks why. The other says he's lying on a nail, but it doesn't hurt him enough.

Kevin says people are the same. They don't like their house, their job or their situation, but the discomfort never gets big enough to force a change.

Change often starts when staying put hurts more than moving.

What's your version of the nail you keep lying on?

#ad #mindset #motivation #kevintrudeau
KT_WEALTH/01_concernword_49s.mp4:
One word kept sinking his deals, and he didn't even notice.

Kevin tells about a friend who taught success seminars but kept stumbling in business. On every deal he said, "I have a concern."

Kevin points out that a concern is fear put into words. His advice: swap it for "I have a question" or "there's something here we can make better."

Same situation, but now you're the one steering the conversation.

What word do you use out of habit without noticing?

#ad #mindset #communication #kevintrudeau
KT_WORDS/01_twowordsiam_56s.mp4:
The two most powerful words you say every day, usually without thinking.

Kevin explains that whatever you put after "I am" is taken by your mind as a statement about your whole being. "I am a loser." "I am a shy person."

Say it often enough and it becomes a fact about yourself. It won't change until you change the words first.

It's a small habit to notice, and you can start today.

What do you usually say after "I am"?
